label: Walk (se), stepping along the ground
note: The shipped Alex walk's motion, as data: each leg's sole steps up to 5 px along the ground diagonal (a shear about the hip, not a turn), the swinging foot lifts up to 4 px, each hand swings 9 px with the opposite foot, the body rises 1 px except on the passing frames. step tracks are px along the ground; the generator turns them into an EffectCraft null (rotation + non-uniform scale) above the limb.
